column4: What to do with this experiment?
column18: Status needed to consider ID(s) to be ready to use
column22: Email to notify when ready (or status changes) - via Construct Tracker

column3:
=ifs(A3="","",
and(D3<>"",not(regexmatch(D3,"[Pp]roceed"))),D3,
S3="","specify construct(s)/ID(s) needed",
W3="",if(T3="Ready","ready to start",T3),
Y3="","in progress",
TRUE,"Complete ♥"
)&
let(entry_list, {F3:I3,K3,M3:Q3,U3,W3:Z3},
ifs(
index(entry_list,1)="","",
NOT(regexmatch(join("◆",entry_list),"[^◆]◆{2,}[^◆]")),"",
true,char(10)&"missing data?"
))
column20:
=ifs(or(A3="",S3=""),"",
Y3<>"","Complete",
W3<>"","In progress",
FALSE,"This code duplicates part of the adjacent column but provides the trigger for email notifications, so only email-worthy messages/changes should display here",TRUE,
let(entries,transpose(split(join(",",O3,Q3),", ")),
let(
 construct_names,iferror(filter(entries,not(regexmatch(entries,"^[odagms]\d+$"))),"none"),
 IDs,iferror(filter(entries,regexmatch(entries,"^[odagms]\d+$")),"none"),
let(
  construct_statuses,
  if(construct_names<>"none",byrow(construct_names,lambda(name,iferror(index(Registry_Status,xmatch(name,Registry_Construct_name)),"Construct not found?"))),""),
  IDs_statuses,
  if(IDs<>"none",byrow(IDs,lambda(ID,let(x,GET_STATUS_BY_ID(ID),if(or(x<>"",x<>FALSE),x,"Invalid ID "&ID&"?")))),""),
ifs(
regexmatch(join(",",construct_statuses),"[Aa]bandon"),"Required construct abandoned!",
regexmatch(join(",",construct_statuses),"hold"),"Required construct held?",
regexmatch(join(",",construct_statuses),"Invalid"),"Required construct not found in Registry!",
regexmatch(join(",",IDs_statuses),"⛔"),"Required ID is marked ⛔!",
regexmatch(join(",",IDs_statuses),"stalled"),"Required ID has status 'stalled'!",
regexmatch(join(",",IDs_statuses),"Invalid"),"Required ID not found!",
TRUE,let(output,
   trim(join(char(10),
    ifs(construct_names="none","",counta(construct_statuses)=countif(construct_statuses,"*omplete*"),"Constructs ready",TRUE,"Wait on constructs"),
    ifs(IDs="none","",counta(IDs_statuses)=countif(IDs_statuses,"*"&R3&"*"),"IDs ready",TRUE,"Wait on IDs"))),
if(regexmatch(output,"Wait"),output,"Ready")))
))))
